audits.observations: Root ordered second reading: whole image and both actual supplied halves viewed before image-first receipt and text opening, followed by all38 fresh crops, each personally viewed. Every agreed and differing word, accent, alphabet, formula, index, underline, cancellation and insertion was checked against the ink. The final x in rho(x_i)=sum a_ji tensor x_i has a dotted short i and is retained despite H j. Three physical word divisions and a cancelled comma are restored. Round o/0 subscripts remain consistently doubtful. Proposition underlining is limited to the observed segments; the separate lemma heading line and small gap in the par exemple enclosure are represented. The unmatched relation) parenthesis, two opening curves before qu’on, amended sont, cancelled final s, visible l’exposé and XXV bars remain as written. Seven doubts remain. Manuscript15 and archive46 are distinct. No context or mathematical proof check was used.
